change.title: Revise BPI accepts investment and C/TUI redevelopment agreement
change.reason: Move agreement associations out of subject_ids; retain one singular agreement_id and remove duplicates. Treat the existing event as BPI’s acceptance of the investment and redevelopment deal, not an unanswered offer. Preserve its ID and date; the agreement establishes commitments without inventing a bank-transfer date.

before.title: Investment and cooperation offer to independent BPI Systems
before.description: Adam offered to invest $150,000 in BPI Systems in return for a 33% fully diluted interest. He also proposed engineering assistance from AION Software and distribution through Logix. BPI retained control of its products, management and brand while considering the investment.

outcomes.description: BPI pursued the engineering and distribution partnership while leaving the proposed equity investment unaccepted.

after.title: BPI accepts investment and C/TUI redevelopment agreement
after.description: BPI Systems accepts Adam’s $150,000 investment in exchange for a 33% fully diluted interest. The agreement obliges AION Software to provide knowledge and resources to refactor BPI’s existing code into C with a competitive text-mode TUI. Further investment supports ports to future systems and platforms, after which BPI has the right to buy back Adam’s shares.

inputs.description: BPI contributes its existing application code and domain knowledge; AION contributes engineering expertise and resources for C and TUI redevelopment.

outcomes.description: BPI accepts the $150,000 subscription for Adam’s 33% fully diluted interest and the accompanying AION C/TUI redevelopment obligations. The deal also provides for further platform-porting investment and BPI’s subsequent right to buy back Adam’s shares.
